source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Public Data API v1 (no key)
missing_note: BLS published no index level for the months listed (a blank in the CSV); analyses must exclude or declare an imputation for every month that needs them.
vintage_note: Seasonally adjusted indexes are revised each February for the previous five years: this file is the vintage published on the retrieval date, not the real-time vintage a forecaster had.
